verdict.rationale: Community evidence (svelte-comm-1, svelte-comm-3) references SvelteKit's file-based routing, form actions, and layout/route hierarchy, confirming a first-party routing solution exists and is widely used alongside Svelte, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents SvelteKit from first-party docs as 'the official routing library' nor details its integration depth. missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly naming SvelteKit as the official router, details on route integration mechanics, and independent confirmation of seamless integration beyond folder-structure complaints.
